topics.topic: Subject identity fact stored by an import AuditEntry
questions: What identity-only fact does the import AuditEntry store as its subject?
What subject fact does an import AuditEntry actually carry when MigrationClosure has no identity?

quotes: the subject, by identity only (R0-37), one of a closed set fixed by the action (owner, 2026-10-31; codex round-02 T4): the project (`project_id`) for a project's actions; the customer (`customer_ref`) for a customer's actions, restricting and lifting, ending and resuming; the session and the project for a grant or a revocation; the migration closure (M10) for the import; none for an erasure of old entries, whose fact is the owner's date;

Facts, written once: the instant the import succeeded; the acting principal (the owner, M07); the confirmation id ("Identity formats"); the identity of the file accepted, as a digest, so the audit can name what was imported without its values.

Substitution: there is at most one, and two records of "the migration succeeded at instant T" would mean the same thing. Continuity: it is written once and never changes; it is a fact about the instance, not a thing with a life.
judgement.divergence: One implementer stores no import subject because the singleton MigrationClosure has no identity; another stores a surrogate fact such as the closure's confirmation id or accepted-file digest, which the owner notices when reading the audit log and its contract.
judgement.why: State 1 leaves the import AuditEntry's subject fact undefined even though it requires an identity-only subject.

topics.topic: Whether ArtifactPointers are owned Project facts or independent project-referencing records
questions: Is the Project-to-artifact-pointer collection a fact carried by M01, or are ArtifactPointers independent records that merely reference a Project and survive its anonymisation?
Does a Project carry an owned collection of ArtifactPointers as one of its facts, or are ArtifactPointers independent records that only carry a project reference?

quotes: The facts listed under a model are all its facts, and the facts a create request supplies are named with it (State 0, "Carried to later states"); a fact that may be absent says so in domain words ("when given").
its rooms (M03), owned by the project (R0-10);

An anonymised project is a Project with status `archived` and the anonymised mark: it keeps its `project_id`, its status, that mark and its artifact pointers (M05) and nothing else (R0-62, R0-87) — name, alias, object, customer link, rooms, revision and every instant are gone; when it was archived and when it was anonymised, the audit log says (M09).
Durable, owned by its Project record; kept after anonymisation (R0-62).
judgement.divergence: One implementer embeds an owned pointer collection in each Project and preserves it through anonymisation; another stores independent ArtifactPointer records that reference the project, which owners and services notice through pointer history, project erasure, and persistence behavior.
judgement.why: The texts require pointers to survive with the project but do not settle whether that relationship is a Project fact or an independent referencing record.

topics.topic: Whether adding a room advances the Project revision and last-changed instant
questions: Is adding a room a change to the Project that increments its revision and last-changed instant, or is the room relationship outside the revisioned Project facts?

Is adding a room an accepted change to the Project whose revision and last-changed instant must move, or is the room collection outside the Project's revision boundary despite being listed as a Project fact?

quotes: A Project and a Customer carry a revision, an ordinal starting at 1 that every accepted change moves by one.
its rooms (M03), owned by the project (R0-10);
It does not move by: adding a room, publishing or withdrawing a pointer, a session grant, archiving an archived project (R0-12) or anonymising an anonymised one (R0-71).
judgement.why: Adding a room changes a fact the Project carries, so the universal revision rule conflicts with the explicit rule that adding a room does not move the revision and last-changed pair.

topics.topic: Which attempted, read, no-op, or state-changing actions create AuditEntries
questions: Can refused attempts or agent-authority reads create AuditEntries, or are AuditEntries limited to the accepted significant state changes enumerated in State 0?
Does an accepted action that makes no state change create an AuditEntry?

quotes: the outcome (accepted; whether refused attempts are recorded is settled in State 2, round 28 P1);
None for identity. Whether refused attempts and agent-authority reads leave an entry is State 2's (round 28 P1; R0-58 says ordinary reads do not).
Which actions must state the revision they were made against is State 2's (carried, R0-35).
judgement.why: Whether an invocation is refused, accepted as a no-op, or audit-worthy is an operation rule explicitly assigned to State 2.

questions: Is an AuditEntry identified solely by its ordinal sequence number, by a Registry-minted UUID, or by both?

topics.topic: Facts accepted or required by the create-project action
questions: Exactly which Project facts may or must the create-project action receive: display name, alias, customer_ref, object address, object kind, object characteristics, and/or initial rooms?

topics.topic: Project identity issuer in non-production instances
questions: Who supplies or mints a Project’s identity when a project is created in a test instance: that Registry, or the caller under the residual R0-07 rule?

topics.topic: Retention location for an imported archival instant after anonymisation
questions: Where is the archived instant of a project imported already archived kept after that project is anonymised, given that the Project loses the instant and the single import AuditEntry does not record a per-project archival event?

topics.topic: Whether anonymisation performs a final revision transition before removing revision facts
questions: Does the first anonymisation increment the Project revision and last-changed instant before those facts are removed, or does anonymisation remove them without such a revision transition?

topics.topic: Whether imported Projects retain or replace their source display names
questions: Must every imported Project receive a new display name, is a replacement optional except when the source name violates R0-82, or may every source display name be retained?
